verdict.rationale: An engineer can assemble trigger-and-action automations from Notion's developer platform. Webhooks POST real-time events such as page updates, property changes and new comments to an endpoint, and the REST API can then create or update pages and databases. Internal connections are described as ideal for custom automations and workflows. However, this requires writing and hosting your own code, and the evidence never shows a native, built-in rule builder that pairs triggers with actions. Missing for 10: a documented native automation-rule builder, documented examples of conditions or action chaining, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building such rules.
